corpus_row.citation: Langin T, Capy P, Daboussi MJ (1995) The transposable element impala, a fungal member of the Tc1-mariner superfamily. Mol Gen Genet 246(1):19-28 (PMID 7823909) - superfamily assignment stated verbatim in the title. Hua-Van A, Pamphile JA, Langin T, Daboussi MJ (2001) Transposition of autonomous and engineered impala transposons in Fusarium oxysporum and a related species. Mol Gen Genet 264(5):724-731 (PMID 11212928) - experimental demonstration of autonomous transposition.
corpus_row.why_safe: The Tc1-mariner assignment appears verbatim in the primary paper's title, derived from transposase (DDE) sequence comparison rather than from any annotation tool, and autonomy was demonstrated experimentally in 2001. The deposit IS the element and is exceptionally clean: mobile_element 1..1281 (mobile_element_type=transposon:impala), 27 bp inverted repeat_regions at 1..27 and 1255..1281, and one complete transposase CDS 133..1155 (AAB33090.2). Strain FOM24, clone imp160, subfamily E; organism recorded here at binomial rank, the deposit specifies forma specialis melonis. Note this record supersedes S75106.1.
